name: lumen
description: Themed Claude Code replies: colored text, tables, code, diagrams and charts, figures, bubbles, tool rows and diff cards in 16 themes

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Draw replies with lumen. Off falls back to Claude Code's own renderer.

surfaces.title: Surfaces
surfaces.description: Where lumen draws: all, or a comma-separated list of terminal, desktop, vscode, mobile. The rest use Claude Code's own renderer.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The color theme. random picks a dark theme each time the mod loads.

codeStyle.title: Code block style
codeStyle.description: plain: no frame. framed: a rounded box. filled: a background. card: a rounded box on a background.

tableStyle.title: Table style
tableStyle.description: box: every cell boxed. grid: framed, no lines between rows. rules: horizontal rules only. minimal: a rule under the header.

tableLayout.title: Table layout
tableLayout.description: classic: columns share the width. auto: stack rows as cards when the longest words do not fit. compact: columns at their longest word. stacked: always cards.

headingStyle.title: Heading style
headingStyle.description: banner: a box around H1, a heavy rule under H2. bold, underline (H1 and H2), uppercase (H1).

listMarker.title: List marker
listMarker.description: dots: bullets nested as dots. dash: - at every level, pastes as a markdown list.

taskStyle.title: Task list style
taskStyle.description: checks: [ ] [✓]. ticks: ○ ✓. box: □ ✓. progress: ticks with a done-count bar.

highlightNumbers.title: Highlight numbers
highlightNumbers.description: Numbers, versions, durations, sizes and percentages in the number color.

highlightPaths.title: Highlight paths
highlightPaths.description: File paths in the path color.

promptStyle.title: Prompt style
promptStyle.description: bubble: your prompt on the right in a filled bubble. framed: the same with no fill. wide: a full-width box. bar: an accent bar. chevron: a bold ❯. off: Claude Code's own.

replyStyle.title: Reply style
replyStyle.description: auto: bubble while prompts are bubbles, else off. bubble: a framed, filled bubble. solid: filled to the edge. framed: a frame, no fill. off: a dot before the first line.

bubbleLabels.title: Bubble labels
bubbleLabels.description: small: You ● and ● Claude over the bubbles. large: a bigger ⬤ (some terminals draw it wider than one column). off: no labels.

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: Show when you sent each prompt and when each turn finished.

toolRows.title: Tool rows
toolRows.description: Draw each tool call as one row (Ran, Read, Edited) with a status dot, and edits as diff cards.

toolStyle.title: Tool row style
toolStyle.description: chat: dimmed on the right. tree-dim: under the reply with ⎿, dimmed. tree-bold: tree-dim with one-line sentences in bold. classic: bold verb, full brightness.

toolOutput.title: Tool output
toolOutput.description: full: output as usual. quiet: nothing under reads and read-only commands. rows: nothing under any call that worked (edits keep their diff, failures their error).

diffStyle.title: Diff style
diffStyle.description: card: a rounded box with tinted lines. full: lines tinted across the width. marks: colored + and − only. bar: a colored ▌ before changed lines.

commandOutput.title: Slash command output
commandOutput.description: Draw slash command output that holds markdown (tables, lists, code) like a reply.

mermaid.title: Mermaid diagrams
mermaid.description: Draw ```mermaid blocks as diagrams and charts. Off keeps them as code.

mermaidAscii.title: ASCII diagrams
mermaidAscii.description: Draw diagram lines with + - | instead of box characters.

pieStyle.title: Pie style
pieStyle.description: round: a circle with a legend. bars: one bar per slice.

statusMatrix.title: Status tables
statusMatrix.description: color: status cells (✓ passed, ✗ failed, pending) in theme colors. summary: plus a count line. group: plus rows grouped by status.

testMatrix.title: Test result tables
testMatrix.description: report: a line under a table of test results with the share passed, other results and total time.

benchTable.title: Benchmark tables
benchTable.description: color: changes green for an improvement, red for a regression. trend: plus a sparkline of the runs.

schemaTable.title: Schema tables
schemaTable.description: types: type cells by family. keys: PK, FK, unique marked. full: both.

compareTable.title: Comparison tables
compareTable.description: rank: rank cells as medals. pick: the top score marked. full: both.

apiTable.title: API tables
apiTable.description: verbs: method cells by HTTP verb. auth: auth schemes marked. full: both.

kvTable.title: Config tables
kvTable.description: sources: source cells by origin. overrides: values off their default marked. full: both.

latex.title: LaTeX math
latex.description: Typeset $$ and ```math formulas as images in kitty and Ghostty (needs ratex-render on PATH). Elsewhere they stay text.

footnotes.title: Footnotes
footnotes.description: Draw [^1] footnote marks as superscripts with the notes at the end of the reply.

clickablePaths.title: Clickable paths
clickablePaths.description: Make file paths and editor links in replies open on click (never programs or scripts).

diagramHints.title: Diagram hints
diagramHints.description: Add a short model-only note to each prompt saying diagrams, charts and figures render here (about 600 tokens).

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Colors reply bullet, H3+ headings, quote bar. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty keeps the theme's.
